proposed_facts.text: The notice board lists taxes, curfew rules, and a warning about a missing patrol.
A gate serjeant manages the crowd and keeps one eye on the roster board.
A tavern runner trades hot stew and rumors near the rain barrel.
Threadbare watchers and refugees cluster along the muddy gate line.
Ash Compact census delays have tightened the eastern caravan choke point.
Rain spatters soot-dark stone; frayed banners hang above Cinderwatch's eastern gate.
Refugees, wagons, and foot traffic clog the muddy approach; guards hold the choke while the crowd presses in.
A notice board lists new taxes, curfews, and a posted warning about a missing patrol.
A tavern runner shouts offers of hot stew and paid rumor.
A well-appointed townhouse overlooking the square flies noble colors—a quiet contrast to the mud and clamor.
One figure in threadbare clothes stands uncannily still, gaze flicking to packs and faces more than the gate queue.
Cold rain needles Cinderwatch's eastern gate under frayed banners.
The approach is jammed with refugees, wagons, and travelers; guards watch with hard, tired discipline.
A notice board announces new taxes and curfews, and names a missing patrol.
A tavern runner is hawking hot stew and rumor for coin.
A ragged stranger hangs back, watching the crowd more than the queue.

gm_output.player_facing_text: Rain spatters soot-dark stone across Cinderwatch's eastern gate while frayed banners snap above the muddy approach. A tavern runner weaves through the crush, calling offers of hot stew and paid rumor as the notice board waits beside the arch. The queue inches forward in fits, wagon wheels grinding through black ruts while wet canvas slaps against overloaded carts and the smell of damp wool, smoke, and sour road dust clings to everyone close enough to breathe on you. Somewhere ahead, a guard captain's voice cuts through the mutter of the crowd, sharp enough to make shoulders hunch and conversations die for a heartbeat before the pressure of bodies closes in again. Near the line, one threadbare watcher stands too still, eyes flicking to packs and faces instead of the arch. You can read the notice board, press the guards, approach the tavern runner, or watch the silent figure in the crush.

attempt_1.text: Rain spatters soot-dark stone across Cinderwatch's eastern gate while frayed banners snap above the muddy approach. You stand in the churned mud before the gate as refugees press shoulder to shoulder around the wagon line and guards hold the choke under shouted orders. A tavern runner weaves through the crush, calling offers of hot stew and paid rumor as the notice board waits beside the arch. The queue inches forward in fits, wagon wheels grinding through black ruts while wet canvas slaps against overloaded carts and the smell of damp wool, smoke, and sour road dust clings to everyone close enough to breathe on you. Somewhere ahead, a guard captain's voice cuts through the mutter of the crowd, sharp enough to make shoulders hunch and conversations die for a heartbeat before the pressure of bodies closes in again. To your left, a well-appointed townhouse flies noble colors above the square, clean banners staring down at the mud as if the gate's misery belongs to another city. Near the line, one threadbare watcher stands too still, eyes flicking to packs and faces instead of the arch. You can read the notice board, press the guards, approach the tavern runner, or watch the silent figure in the crush.

acceptance.text: Rain spatters soot-dark stone across Cinderwatch's eastern gate while frayed banners snap above the muddy approach. A tavern runner weaves through the crush, calling offers of hot stew and paid rumor as the notice board waits beside the arch. The queue inches forward in fits, wagon wheels grinding through black ruts while wet canvas slaps against overloaded carts and the smell of damp wool, smoke, and sour road dust clings to everyone close enough to breathe on you. Somewhere ahead, a guard captain's voice cuts through the mutter of the crowd, sharp enough to make shoulders hunch and conversations die for a heartbeat before the pressure of bodies closes in again. Near the line, one threadbare watcher stands too still, eyes flicking to packs and faces instead of the arch. You can read the notice board, press the guards, approach the tavern runner, or watch the silent figure in the crush.

proposed_facts.text: The notice board lists taxes, curfew rules, and a warning about a missing patrol.
A gate serjeant manages the crowd and keeps one eye on the roster board.
A tavern runner trades hot stew and rumors near the rain barrel.
Threadbare watchers and refugees cluster along the muddy gate line.
Ash Compact census delays have tightened the eastern caravan choke point.
Rain spatters soot-dark stone; frayed banners hang above Cinderwatch's eastern gate.
Refugees, wagons, and foot traffic clog the muddy approach; guards hold the choke while the crowd presses in.
A notice board lists new taxes, curfews, and a posted warning about a missing patrol.
A tavern runner shouts offers of hot stew and paid rumor.
A well-appointed townhouse overlooking the square flies noble colors—a quiet contrast to the mud and clamor.
One figure in threadbare clothes stands uncannily still, gaze flicking to packs and faces more than the gate queue.
Cold rain needles Cinderwatch's eastern gate under frayed banners.
The approach is jammed with refugees, wagons, and travelers; guards watch with hard, tired discipline.
A notice board announces new taxes and curfews, and names a missing patrol.
A tavern runner is hawking hot stew and rumor for coin.
A ragged stranger hangs back, watching the crowd more than the queue.
Gate Guard exists
Gate Serjeant exists
Tavern Runner exists
Rain spatters soot-dark stone across Cinderwatch's eastern gate while frayed banners snap above the muddy approach.

The queue inches forward in fits, wagon wheels grinding through black ruts while wet canvas slaps against overloaded carts and the smell of damp wool, smoke, and sour road dust clings to everyone close enough to breathe on you.

Somewhere ahead, a guard captain's voice cuts through the mutter of the crowd, sharp enough to make shoulders hunch and conversations die for a heartbeat before the pressure of bodies closes in again.
A weathered stone milestone leans beside the northwest mud track.
The mud around the marker is churned with faint overlapping prints that fade into the scrub.
The track continues a short way past the stone before rainwater and brush make the next step unclear.
Return to Cinderwatch Gate
Location changes from frontier_gate to old_milestone

attempt_1.text: Rain spatters soot-dark stone across Cinderwatch's eastern gate while frayed banners snap above the muddy approach. You stand in the churned mud before the gate as refugees press shoulder to shoulder around the wagon line and guards hold the choke under shouted orders. A tavern runner weaves through the crush, calling offers of hot stew and paid rumor as the notice board waits beside the arch. The queue inches forward in fits, wagon wheels grinding through black ruts while wet canvas slaps against overloaded carts and the smell of damp wool, smoke, and sour road dust clings to everyone close enough to breathe on you. Somewhere ahead, a guard captain's voice cuts through the mutter of the crowd, sharp enough to make shoulders hunch and conversations die for a heartbeat before the pressure of bodies closes in again. To your left, a well-appointed townhouse flies noble colors above the square, clean banners staring down at the mud as if the gate's misery belongs to another city. Near the line, one threadbare watcher stands too still, eyes flicking to packs and faces instead of the arch. You can read the notice board, press the guards, approach the tavern runner, or watch the silent figure in the crush.

attempt_2.text: Rain spatters soot-dark stone across Cinderwatch's eastern gate while frayed banners snap above the muddy approach. You stand in the churned mud before the gate as refugees press shoulder to shoulder around the wagon line and guards hold the choke under shouted orders. A tavern runner weaves through the crush, calling offers of hot stew and paid rumor as the notice board waits beside the arch. The queue inches forward in fits, wagon wheels grinding through black ruts while wet canvas slaps against overloaded carts and the smell of damp wool, smoke, and sour road dust clings to everyone close enough to breathe on you. Somewhere ahead, a guard captain's voice cuts through the mutter of the crowd, sharp enough to make shoulders hunch and conversations die for a heartbeat before the pressure of bodies closes in again. To your left, a well-appointed townhouse flies noble colors above the square, clean banners staring down at the mud as if the gate's misery belongs to another city. Near the line, one threadbare watcher stands too still, eyes flicking to packs and faces instead of the arch. You can read the notice board, press the guards, approach the tavern runner, or watch the silent figure in the crush.

attempt_1.text: Rain spatters soot-dark stone across Cinderwatch's eastern gate while frayed banners snap above the muddy approach. You stand in the churned mud before the gate as refugees press shoulder to shoulder around the wagon line and guards hold the choke under shouted orders. A tavern runner weaves through the crush, calling offers of hot stew and paid rumor as the notice board waits beside the arch. The queue inches forward in fits, wagon wheels grinding through black ruts while wet canvas slaps against overloaded carts and the smell of damp wool, smoke, and sour road dust clings to everyone close enough to breathe on you. Somewhere ahead, a guard captain's voice cuts through the mutter of the crowd, sharp enough to make shoulders hunch and conversations die for a heartbeat before the pressure of bodies closes in again. To your left, a well-appointed townhouse flies noble colors above the square, clean banners staring down at the mud as if the gate's misery belongs to another city. Near the line, one threadbare watcher stands too still, eyes flicking to packs and faces instead of the arch. You can read the notice board, press the guards, approach the tavern runner, or watch the silent figure in the crush.

attempt_2.text: Rain spatters soot-dark stone across Cinderwatch's eastern gate while frayed banners snap above the muddy approach. You stand in the churned mud before the gate as refugees press shoulder to shoulder around the wagon line and guards hold the choke under shouted orders. A tavern runner weaves through the crush, calling offers of hot stew and paid rumor as the notice board waits beside the arch. The queue inches forward in fits, wagon wheels grinding through black ruts while wet canvas slaps against overloaded carts and the smell of damp wool, smoke, and sour road dust clings to everyone close enough to breathe on you. Somewhere ahead, a guard captain's voice cuts through the mutter of the crowd, sharp enough to make shoulders hunch and conversations die for a heartbeat before the pressure of bodies closes in again. To your left, a well-appointed townhouse flies noble colors above the square, clean banners staring down at the mud as if the gate's misery belongs to another city. Near the line, one threadbare watcher stands too still, eyes flicking to packs and faces instead of the arch. You can read the notice board, press the guards, approach the tavern runner, or watch the silent figure in the crush.

attempt_1.text: Rain spatters soot-dark stone across Cinderwatch's eastern gate while frayed banners snap above the muddy approach. You stand in the churned mud before the gate as refugees press shoulder to shoulder around the wagon line and guards hold the choke under shouted orders. A tavern runner weaves through the crush, calling offers of hot stew and paid rumor as the notice board waits beside the arch. The queue inches forward in fits, wagon wheels grinding through black ruts while wet canvas slaps against overloaded carts and the smell of damp wool, smoke, and sour road dust clings to everyone close enough to breathe on you. Somewhere ahead, a guard captain's voice cuts through the mutter of the crowd, sharp enough to make shoulders hunch and conversations die for a heartbeat before the pressure of bodies closes in again. To your left, a well-appointed townhouse flies noble colors above the square, clean banners staring down at the mud as if the gate's misery belongs to another city. Near the line, one threadbare watcher stands too still, eyes flicking to packs and faces instead of the arch. You can read the notice board, press the guards, approach the tavern runner, or watch the silent figure in the crush.

attempt_2.text: Rain spatters soot-dark stone across Cinderwatch's eastern gate while frayed banners snap above the muddy approach. You stand in the churned mud before the gate as refugees press shoulder to shoulder around the wagon line and guards hold the choke under shouted orders. A tavern runner weaves through the crush, calling offers of hot stew and paid rumor as the notice board waits beside the arch. The queue inches forward in fits, wagon wheels grinding through black ruts while wet canvas slaps against overloaded carts and the smell of damp wool, smoke, and sour road dust clings to everyone close enough to breathe on you. Somewhere ahead, a guard captain's voice cuts through the mutter of the crowd, sharp enough to make shoulders hunch and conversations die for a heartbeat before the pressure of bodies closes in again. To your left, a well-appointed townhouse flies noble colors above the square, clean banners staring down at the mud as if the gate's misery belongs to another city. Near the line, one threadbare watcher stands too still, eyes flicking to packs and faces instead of the arch. You can read the notice board, press the guards, approach the tavern runner, or watch the silent figure in the crush.

attempt_1.text: Rain spatters soot-dark stone across Cinderwatch's eastern gate while frayed banners snap above the muddy approach. You stand in the churned mud before the gate as refugees press shoulder to shoulder around the wagon line and guards hold the choke under shouted orders. A tavern runner weaves through the crush, calling offers of hot stew and paid rumor as the notice board waits beside the arch. The queue inches forward in fits, wagon wheels grinding through black ruts while wet canvas slaps against overloaded carts and the smell of damp wool, smoke, and sour road dust clings to everyone close enough to breathe on you. Somewhere ahead, a guard captain's voice cuts through the mutter of the crowd, sharp enough to make shoulders hunch and conversations die for a heartbeat before the pressure of bodies closes in again. To your left, a well-appointed townhouse flies noble colors above the square, clean banners staring down at the mud as if the gate's misery belongs to another city. Near the line, one threadbare watcher stands too still, eyes flicking to packs and faces instead of the arch. You can read the notice board, press the guards, approach the tavern runner, or watch the silent figure in the crush.

attempt_2.text: Rain spatters soot-dark stone across Cinderwatch's eastern gate while frayed banners snap above the muddy approach. You stand in the churned mud before the gate as refugees press shoulder to shoulder around the wagon line and guards hold the choke under shouted orders. A tavern runner weaves through the crush, calling offers of hot stew and paid rumor as the notice board waits beside the arch. The queue inches forward in fits, wagon wheels grinding through black ruts while wet canvas slaps against overloaded carts and the smell of damp wool, smoke, and sour road dust clings to everyone close enough to breathe on you. Somewhere ahead, a guard captain's voice cuts through the mutter of the crowd, sharp enough to make shoulders hunch and conversations die for a heartbeat before the pressure of bodies closes in again. To your left, a well-appointed townhouse flies noble colors above the square, clean banners staring down at the mud as if the gate's misery belongs to another city. Near the line, one threadbare watcher stands too still, eyes flicking to packs and faces instead of the arch. You can read the notice board, press the guards, approach the tavern runner, or watch the silent figure in the crush.

attempt_1.text: Rain spatters soot-dark stone across Cinderwatch's eastern gate while frayed banners snap above the muddy approach. You stand in the churned mud before the gate as refugees press shoulder to shoulder around the wagon line and guards hold the choke under shouted orders. A tavern runner weaves through the crush, calling offers of hot stew and paid rumor as the notice board waits beside the arch. The queue inches forward in fits, wagon wheels grinding through black ruts while wet canvas slaps against overloaded carts and the smell of damp wool, smoke, and sour road dust clings to everyone close enough to breathe on you. Somewhere ahead, a guard captain's voice cuts through the mutter of the crowd, sharp enough to make shoulders hunch and conversations die for a heartbeat before the pressure of bodies closes in again. To your left, a well-appointed townhouse flies noble colors above the square, clean banners staring down at the mud as if the gate's misery belongs to another city. Near the line, one threadbare watcher stands too still, eyes flicking to packs and faces instead of the arch. You can read the notice board, press the guards, approach the tavern runner, or watch the silent figure in the crush.

attempt_2.text: Rain spatters soot-dark stone across Cinderwatch's eastern gate while frayed banners snap above the muddy approach. You stand in the churned mud before the gate as refugees press shoulder to shoulder around the wagon line and guards hold the choke under shouted orders. A tavern runner weaves through the crush, calling offers of hot stew and paid rumor as the notice board waits beside the arch. The queue inches forward in fits, wagon wheels grinding through black ruts while wet canvas slaps against overloaded carts and the smell of damp wool, smoke, and sour road dust clings to everyone close enough to breathe on you. Somewhere ahead, a guard captain's voice cuts through the mutter of the crowd, sharp enough to make shoulders hunch and conversations die for a heartbeat before the pressure of bodies closes in again. To your left, a well-appointed townhouse flies noble colors above the square, clean banners staring down at the mud as if the gate's misery belongs to another city. Near the line, one threadbare watcher stands too still, eyes flicking to packs and faces instead of the arch. You can read the notice board, press the guards, approach the tavern runner, or watch the silent figure in the crush.

attempt_1.text: Rain spatters soot-dark stone across Cinderwatch's eastern gate while frayed banners snap above the muddy approach. You stand in the churned mud before the gate as refugees press shoulder to shoulder around the wagon line and guards hold the choke under shouted orders. A tavern runner weaves through the crush, calling offers of hot stew and paid rumor as the notice board waits beside the arch. The queue inches forward in fits, wagon wheels grinding through black ruts while wet canvas slaps against overloaded carts and the smell of damp wool, smoke, and sour road dust clings to everyone close enough to breathe on you. Somewhere ahead, a guard captain's voice cuts through the mutter of the crowd, sharp enough to make shoulders hunch and conversations die for a heartbeat before the pressure of bodies closes in again. To your left, a well-appointed townhouse flies noble colors above the square, clean banners staring down at the mud as if the gate's misery belongs to another city. Near the line, one threadbare watcher stands too still, eyes flicking to packs and faces instead of the arch. You can read the notice board, press the guards, approach the tavern runner, or watch the silent figure in the crush.

acceptance.text: Rain spatters soot-dark stone across Cinderwatch's eastern gate while frayed banners snap above the muddy approach. A tavern runner weaves through the crush, calling offers of hot stew and paid rumor as the notice board waits beside the arch. The queue inches forward in fits, wagon wheels grinding through black ruts while wet canvas slaps against overloaded carts and the smell of damp wool, smoke, and sour road dust clings to everyone close enough to breathe on you. Somewhere ahead, a guard captain's voice cuts through the mutter of the crowd, sharp enough to make shoulders hunch and conversations die for a heartbeat before the pressure of bodies closes in again. Near the line, one threadbare watcher stands too still, eyes flicking to packs and faces instead of the arch. You can read the notice board, press the guards, approach the tavern runner, or watch the silent figure in the crush.

attempt_1.text: Rain spatters soot-dark stone across Cinderwatch's eastern gate while frayed banners snap above the muddy approach. You stand in the churned mud before the gate as refugees press shoulder to shoulder around the wagon line and guards hold the choke under shouted orders. A tavern runner weaves through the crush, calling offers of hot stew and paid rumor as the notice board waits beside the arch. The queue inches forward in fits, wagon wheels grinding through black ruts while wet canvas slaps against overloaded carts and the smell of damp wool, smoke, and sour road dust clings to everyone close enough to breathe on you. Somewhere ahead, a guard captain's voice cuts through the mutter of the crowd, sharp enough to make shoulders hunch and conversations die for a heartbeat before the pressure of bodies closes in again. To your left, a well-appointed townhouse flies noble colors above the square, clean banners staring down at the mud as if the gate's misery belongs to another city. Near the line, one threadbare watcher stands too still, eyes flicking to packs and faces instead of the arch. You can read the notice board, press the guards, approach the tavern runner, or watch the silent figure in the crush.

attempt_2.text: Rain spatters soot-dark stone across Cinderwatch's eastern gate while frayed banners snap above the muddy approach. You stand in the churned mud before the gate as refugees press shoulder to shoulder around the wagon line and guards hold the choke under shouted orders. A tavern runner weaves through the crush, calling offers of hot stew and paid rumor as the notice board waits beside the arch. The queue inches forward in fits, wagon wheels grinding through black ruts while wet canvas slaps against overloaded carts and the smell of damp wool, smoke, and sour road dust clings to everyone close enough to breathe on you. Somewhere ahead, a guard captain's voice cuts through the mutter of the crowd, sharp enough to make shoulders hunch and conversations die for a heartbeat before the pressure of bodies closes in again. To your left, a well-appointed townhouse flies noble colors above the square, clean banners staring down at the mud as if the gate's misery belongs to another city. Near the line, one threadbare watcher stands too still, eyes flicking to packs and faces instead of the arch. You can read the notice board, press the guards, approach the tavern runner, or watch the silent figure in the crush.

hard_validation_attempt_1.text: Rain spatters soot-dark stone across Cinderwatch's eastern gate while frayed banners snap above the muddy approach. You stand in the churned mud before the gate as refugees press shoulder to shoulder around the wagon line and guards hold the choke under shouted orders. A tavern runner weaves through the crush, calling offers of hot stew and paid rumor as the notice board waits beside the arch. The queue inches forward in fits, wagon wheels grinding through black ruts while wet canvas slaps against overloaded carts and the smell of damp wool, smoke, and sour road dust clings to everyone close enough to breathe on you. Somewhere ahead, a guard captain's voice cuts through the mutter of the crowd, sharp enough to make shoulders hunch and conversations die for a heartbeat before the pressure of bodies closes in again. To your left, a well-appointed townhouse flies noble colors above the square, clean banners staring down at the mud as if the gate's misery belongs to another city. attempt_1.text: Rain spatters soot-dark stone across Cinderwatch's eastern gate while frayed banners snap above the muddy approach. You stand in the churned mud before the gate as refugees press shoulder to shoulder around the wagon line and guards hold the choke under shouted orders. A tavern runner weaves through the crush, calling offers of hot stew and paid rumor as the notice board waits beside the arch. The queue inches forward in fits, wagon wheels grinding through black ruts while wet canvas slaps against overloaded carts and the smell of damp wool, smoke, and sour road dust clings to everyone close enough to breathe on you. Somewhere ahead, a guard captain's voice cuts through the mutter of the crowd, sharp enough to make shoulders hunch and conversations die for a heartbeat before the pressure of bodies closes in again. To your left, a well-appointed townhouse flies noble colors above the square, clean banners staring down at the mud as if the gate's misery belongs to another city. Near the line, one threadbare watcher stands too still, eyes flicking to packs and faces instead of the arch. You can read the notice board, press the guards, approach the tavern runner, or watch the silent figure in the crush.

A tavern runner weaves through the crush, calling offers of hot stew and paid rumor as the notice board waits beside the arch.

The queue inches forward in fits, wagon wheels grinding through black ruts while wet canvas slaps against overloaded carts and the smell of damp wool, smoke, and sour road dust clings to everyone close enough to breathe on you.

Somewhere ahead, a guard captain's voice cuts through the mutter of the crowd, sharp enough to make shoulders hunch and conversations die for a heartbeat before the pressure of bodies closes in again.
To your left, a well-appointed townhouse flies noble colors above the square, clean banners staring down at the mud as if the gate's misery belongs to another city.

attempt_2.text: Rain spatters soot-dark stone across Cinderwatch's eastern gate while frayed banners snap above the muddy approach. You stand in the churned mud before the gate as refugees press shoulder to shoulder around the wagon line and guards hold the choke under shouted orders. A tavern runner weaves through the crush, calling offers of hot stew and paid rumor as the notice board waits beside the arch. The queue inches forward in fits, wagon wheels grinding through black ruts while wet canvas slaps against overloaded carts and the smell of damp wool, smoke, and sour road dust clings to everyone close enough to breathe on you. Somewhere ahead, a guard captain's voice cuts through the mutter of the crowd, sharp enough to make shoulders hunch and conversations die for a heartbeat before the pressure of bodies closes in again. To your left, a well-appointed townhouse flies noble colors above the square, clean banners staring down at the mud as if the gate's misery belongs to another city. Near the line, one threadbare watcher stands too still, eyes flicking to packs and faces instead of the arch. You can read the notice board, press the guards, approach the tavern runner, or watch the silent figure in the crush.

The queue inches forward in fits, wagon wheels grinding through black ruts while wet canvas slaps against overloaded carts and the smell of damp wool, smoke, and sour road dust clings to everyone close enough to breathe on you.

attempt_1.text: Rain spatters soot-dark stone across Cinderwatch's eastern gate while frayed banners snap above the muddy approach. You stand in the churned mud before the gate as refugees press shoulder to shoulder around the wagon line and guards hold the choke under shouted orders. A tavern runner weaves through the crush, calling offers of hot stew and paid rumor as the notice board waits beside the arch. The queue inches forward in fits, wagon wheels grinding through black ruts while wet canvas slaps against overloaded carts and the smell of damp wool, smoke, and sour road dust clings to everyone close enough to breathe on you. Somewhere ahead, a guard captain's voice cuts through the mutter of the crowd, sharp enough to make shoulders hunch and conversations die for a heartbeat before the pressure of bodies closes in again. To your left, a well-appointed townhouse flies noble colors above the square, clean banners staring down at the mud as if the gate's misery belongs to another city. Near the line, one threadbare watcher stands too still, eyes flicking to packs and faces instead of the arch. You can read the notice board, press the guards, approach the tavern runner, or watch the silent figure in the crush.

attempt_2.text: Rain spatters soot-dark stone across Cinderwatch's eastern gate while frayed banners snap above the muddy approach. You stand in the churned mud before the gate as refugees press shoulder to shoulder around the wagon line and guards hold the choke under shouted orders. A tavern runner weaves through the crush, calling offers of hot stew and paid rumor as the notice board waits beside the arch. The queue inches forward in fits, wagon wheels grinding through black ruts while wet canvas slaps against overloaded carts and the smell of damp wool, smoke, and sour road dust clings to everyone close enough to breathe on you. Somewhere ahead, a guard captain's voice cuts through the mutter of the crowd, sharp enough to make shoulders hunch and conversations die for a heartbeat before the pressure of bodies closes in again. To your left, a well-appointed townhouse flies noble colors above the square, clean banners staring down at the mud as if the gate's misery belongs to another city. Near the line, one threadbare watcher stands too still, eyes flicking to packs and faces instead of the arch. You can read the notice board, press the guards, approach the tavern runner, or watch the silent figure in the crush.

attempt_1.text: Rain spatters soot-dark stone across Cinderwatch's eastern gate while frayed banners snap above the muddy approach. You stand in the churned mud before the gate as refugees press shoulder to shoulder around the wagon line and guards hold the choke under shouted orders. A tavern runner weaves through the crush, calling offers of hot stew and paid rumor as the notice board waits beside the arch. The queue inches forward in fits, wagon wheels grinding through black ruts while wet canvas slaps against overloaded carts and the smell of damp wool, smoke, and sour road dust clings to everyone close enough to breathe on you. Somewhere ahead, a guard captain's voice cuts through the mutter of the crowd, sharp enough to make shoulders hunch and conversations die for a heartbeat before the pressure of bodies closes in again. To your left, a well-appointed townhouse flies noble colors above the square, clean banners staring down at the mud as if the gate's misery belongs to another city. Near the line, one threadbare watcher stands too still, eyes flicking to packs and faces instead of the arch. You can read the notice board, press the guards, approach the tavern runner, or watch the silent figure in the crush.

attempt_2.text: Rain spatters soot-dark stone across Cinderwatch's eastern gate while frayed banners snap above the muddy approach. You stand in the churned mud before the gate as refugees press shoulder to shoulder around the wagon line and guards hold the choke under shouted orders. A tavern runner weaves through the crush, calling offers of hot stew and paid rumor as the notice board waits beside the arch. The queue inches forward in fits, wagon wheels grinding through black ruts while wet canvas slaps against overloaded carts and the smell of damp wool, smoke, and sour road dust clings to everyone close enough to breathe on you. Somewhere ahead, a guard captain's voice cuts through the mutter of the crowd, sharp enough to make shoulders hunch and conversations die for a heartbeat before the pressure of bodies closes in again. To your left, a well-appointed townhouse flies noble colors above the square, clean banners staring down at the mud as if the gate's misery belongs to another city. Near the line, one threadbare watcher stands too still, eyes flicking to packs and faces instead of the arch. You can read the notice board, press the guards, approach the tavern runner, or watch the silent figure in the crush.
